desc: The Midwest Industries SP Series M-LOK Handguard is a rugged one-piece design constructed of 6061 aluminum with a hard coat anodized finish. It features a full length Picatinny top rail and M-LOK mounting slots on 7 flats along its length. The SP Series is designed to provide room for a sound suppressor, with an inside diameter of 1.75" and outside diameter of 2".
